name: Kodarma

queries.query: Kodarma Koderma Jharkhand official cadastral parcel map land records Jharbhoomi Bhu Naksha
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the official Koderma district land-record/e-Mutation page, which directs users to the Jharkhand Jharbhoomi portal. The official Bhu-Naksha implementation page identifies Jharkhand's current public viewer as jharbhunaksha.jharkhand.gov.in and records state code 20.

queries.result: First-party discovery identified the official Hindi Koderma district revenue, registration and land-reforms page. It directs users to the same Jharkhand Jharbhoomi land-record portal; no public parcel feature response was obtained.

freshResearch.method: Separate English and Hindi first-party discovery followed by bounded TLS-verified anonymous GET attempts. No credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe fields or TLS disablement were used.

portalsFound.observation: Official Government of India Koderma district page for land records and e-Mutation; it identifies Jharbhoomi as the destination. This is local district service evidence, not an open parcel API response.
Official Hindi Koderma district revenue/land page directing users to Jharbhoomi.

Official NIC Bhu-Naksha implementation-status page identifies Jharkhand state code 20 and links its current viewer to jharbhunaksha.jharkhand.gov.in. National implementation documentation is not treated as citywide geometry evidence.
Jharkhand state land-record portal named by the official Koderma district pages; anonymous request did not return within the bounded timeout.
Jharkhand Bhu-Naksha viewer linked by the official NIC implementation page; anonymous request did not return within the bounded timeout.

requests.assessment: TLS-verified anonymous request timed out after 20 seconds before HTML or JavaScript configuration was returned. No service URL, schema, CRS, native ID or geometry was obtained. This is a route failure, not evidence of citywide absence.
TLS-verified anonymous request timed out after 12 seconds before viewer configuration was returned. No parcel API route or bounded response was obtained.
Official implementation-status HTML was retrieved and inspected for the Jharkhand viewer link and state code 20. It provides implementation metadata only, not Kodarma parcel features.

Official Hindi Koderma district page retrieved; it links to Jharbhoomi but contains no bounded parcel geometry response.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Koderma district official land-record directions and Jharkhand's official Bhu-Naksha implementation/viewer routes.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Local district service custody and official state viewer existence only; no open Kodarma parcel geometry coverage verified.

remainingUncertainty: The current Jharbhoomi/Bhu-Naksha JavaScript configuration, public API route, Koderma urban/village unit identifiers, parcel schema, CRS, stable native identity, update currency and citywide completeness remain unresolved. The exact WUP point was preserved and never shifted; no exact-point hit/miss inference was made. A timeout or unusable viewer is not evidence of cadastral absence.
nextStep: A later attempt may inspect the Jharkhand viewer through an available public route and request only bounded anonymous native ID-plus-geometry data for Kodarma. Serial reviewer qualification remains required; runtime readiness stays held.
